gold_sql_sqlite: WITH r AS (SELECT province_code,AVG(availability_pct) AS avail FROM ran_kpi__cell_hourly GROUP BY province_code),q AS (SELECT province_code,100.0*SUM(success_count)/NULLIF(SUM(request_count),0) AS qos_pct FROM qos__service_hourly GROUP BY province_code),c AS (SELECT province_code,COUNT(*) AS subscribers FROM customer__subscriber GROUP BY province_code),x AS (SELECT province_code,COUNT(*) AS complaints FROM experience__complaint GROUP BY province_code),b AS (SELECT province_code,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN paid_vnd<total_vnd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS unpaid_pct FROM billing__invoice GROUP BY province_code),s AS (SELECT r.province_code,ROUND((100-r.avail)+(100-q.qos_pct)+100.0*COALESCE(x.complaints,0)/NULLIF(c.subscribers,0)+b.unpaid_pct,2) AS risk_score FROM r JOIN q ON r.province_code=q.province_code JOIN c ON r.province_code=c.province_code LEFT JOIN x ON r.province_code=x.province_code JOIN b ON r.province_code=b.province_code) SELECT s.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY risk_score DESC) AS risk_rank FROM s ORDER BY risk_rank,province_code
